Шаг 1 — дизайн Арбузова в новом стиле (d01–d03), владелец выбирает → путь в "design". Шаг 2 — сцены f01–f11 с образцом @design. Шаг 3 — живые вставки c01–c09 (Seedance 2.5 image-to-video, 720p, без звука). Текст и цифры на картинках не рисуем — пуши, чат, ценники кладём кодом поверх.
style: Satirical hand-painted digital illustration for an adult YouTube channel about money: confident ink linework, painterly shading with visible brush texture, volumetric light, soft shadows, realistic muted palette with warm accents, highly detailed lived-in everyday Russian interiors and streets (Soviet-era panel apartments, old fridge with magnets, patterned carpet on the wall, oilcloth on the table, tiled kitchen, cheap supermarket), expressive slightly grotesque faces, cinematic composition, vertical 9:16, main character in the lower-middle part of the frame with free space at the top. Not a kids cartoon, not glossy 3D, not flat vector. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks.
